notes.subject: pes bilong en
notes.rationale: פָּנָיו i tok long 'pes' — Tok Pisin i save tok 'lukluk long pes' bilong tok long presence bilong man, olsem na piksa i stap.

notes.subject: painim Yahwe na strong bilong en
notes.rationale: וְעֻזּוֹ i save tok 'painim Yahwe i gat strong' o 'painim Yahwe, na painim strong bilong en ol tu' — tupela i orait.

notes.subject: ol man i ritim pes
notes.rationale: Tripela tok bilong tokim man: דרשו בקשו — pes i kolim ol man long painim Yahwe.

translation: Painim Yahwe na strong bilong en, lukluk long pes bilong en oltaim.
